name: Oran Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to restore 10 HP.

name: Persim Berry
description: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to lift confusion.

name: Macho Brace
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It promotes strong growth but lowers Speed while it is held.

name: Muscle Band
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a headband that slightly boosts the power of physical moves.

name: Wise Glasses
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of special moves.

name: Punch Glove
description: A held item that boosts the power of punching moves and prevents direct contact with targets.
